key_insight: The paper combines dimensionality reduction and multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to efficiently optimize expensive process simulators with far fewer high-fidelity evaluations.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical, simulator-agnostic way to cut optimization cost in industrial flowsheet design, especially when evaluations are slow and variables are numerous.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis (GSA) to reduce the design space to the most influential variables.
Model low- and high-fidelity simulator outputs with a fidelity-aware Gaussian process.
Guide sampling with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown and promotion mechanisms.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocessing in SuperPro Designer and green fuel synthesis in Aspen HYSYS—and reduced high-fidelity evaluations while staying competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the reduced space and on meaningful low-fidelity approximations, so poor sensitivity screening or weak fidelity correlation could limit gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
